correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the graph indicator through partition-lattice Mobius inversion, obtains an exact edge-subset zeta transform whose inverse has integer coefficients, and optimizes the two-adic valuations by Legendre's identity. A matching/singleton partition attains the lower bound, a two-block partition rules out odd common divisors, and inverse zeta yields matching-complement witnesses. All n>=1 boundaries are covered. Two full exact independent spectral constructions agree for n<=7; arbitrary-precision witness tests hold through n=200. Finite checks corroborate but are not substituted for the infinite proof.
